claims.text: Integrating Large Language Models with structured knowledge bases combines generative language understanding with precise knowledge representation.
The integration of LLMs and knowledge bases involves technical, operational, and ethical challenges.

evidence.description: This approach aims to combine the generative language understanding of LLMs and the precise knowledge representation systems by which they are integrated.
This article surveys the relationship between LLMs and knowledge bases, looks at how they can be applied in practice, and discusses related technical, operational, and ethical challenges.

methodologies.name: Comprehensive Literature Survey
methodologies.description: A systematic survey analyzing existing literature on the integration of large language models and knowledge-based systems.

limitations.text: Existing solutions for integrating LLMs and knowledge bases encounter technical, operational, and ethical challenges.

future_work.text: Address main research gaps in integrating generative AI with knowledge bases to support practical deployment across various sectors.
